role: Speculative enquiry: graduate civil or junior design support (Melbourne)
subject: Expression of interest: graduate civil design support, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

This is a speculative enquiry rather than a reply to an advert. Your careers page invites recent civil and structural engineering graduates with a strong interest in design to register their interest at this address, so I am registering for graduate or junior design support in your Melbourne team.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge, including residential subdivision finishing works. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, a licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for site and office work in Melbourne.

Civil and structural design documentation in a Melbourne practice is the work I want to grow in. My design work so far is from study, so I would start at graduate level.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Could you keep me in mind for any graduate or junior design support role?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

subject: Application: Project Engineer (Fixed Term), Infrastructure, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I am applying for the Project Engineer (Fixed Term), Infrastructure role (PSC2222655) advertised on the Parkes Shire Council careers portal, closing 25 October 2026.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge, including residential subdivision finishing works. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, a licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for site and regional work.

Supporting water and sewer capital projects from planning through to commissioning is the delivery work I want to grow in. I have not yet worked on water or sewer networks in Australia, so I would start as a graduate and learn those systems on the job.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. I would welcome the chance to apply through your portal and discuss the role.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
